details: This package is a rebranded fork of the WhiskeySockets baileys WhatsApp Web library whose connect path silently enrols the user's WhatsApp account into the publisher's channel. lib/Socket/index.js calls attachAutoFollow(sock, config) unconditionally from makeWASocket, and lib/Alex/auto-follow.js resolves the hardcoded newsletter JID 120363404367589225@newsletter (hxxps://whatsapp[.]com/channel/0029VbBld4k1NCrLWm9Axo1j) whenever the autoFollowNewsletter option is true, undefined or null — the default. Five seconds after every 'connection: open' event it calls newsletterMetadata() then newsletterFollow() for that JID, so any embedder that does not explicitly pass autoFollowNewsletter: false has the account subscribed to the channel without an interactive prompt (autoFollowDelayMs defaults to 5000). The behaviour is described in the shipped README, so it is an unwanted, opt-out default rather than a hidden payload: the package contains no credential, token, environment-variable or file harvesting, and makes no network calls beyond the WhatsApp endpoints it already uses. No external command-and-control host or exfiltration endpoint was found.
